name: SeasonalWorkerOnboardingHub
tagline: Every seasonal worker ready on day one – documents, right-to-work record, training, PPE and beds in one app.
description: A complete Power Apps code component for growers, packhouses and labour providers: follow each seasonal worker from accepted offer to first day with document checklists, a right-to-work check record with expiry alerts, induction and role-based training, PPE issue, accommodation allocation and a readiness board with stage rules. Works in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Stage rules from Invited to Started
Right-to-work check record with expiry alerts
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
